findings: estimateCost preserves JavaScript floating-point arithmetic and separate decimal storage versus binary network units; negative, fractional, NaN and infinite values are unchecked, proof levels are not constrained to 0–4, and unknown AI model keys can throw on property access.

calculateRiskCost does not constrain classification, record count or breach probability; missing classification entries can produce NaN, boolean-like modifiers use truthiness, and penalties are added before probability and exchange-rate multiplication.

selectRoute throws the exact empty-input Error, sorts copied candidates, relies on stable ordering for ties, and allows NaN comparator behavior; budget checking happens before escalation, so escalation can select a higher-proof candidate over budget.

selectRoute keeps the cheapest candidate's flowName even when escalation selects a different candidate, assigns governanceApproved:true unconditionally, and emits explanatory strings without enforcing a stop or seal.
selectVectorTier returns caller input unchanged, including avx512, without hardware detection or AVX2 ceiling enforcement.

All exported pricing, loss, modifier and hardware objects remain mutable at runtime; as const is compile-time only. Calibration comments and tests do not establish current prices or empirical risk accuracy.

The package contains no hardware/backend execution, scheduling, transfer, authority or consumer-enforcement path. Fifteen tests omit the listed numeric, aliasing, mutation, tie-order and governance-boundary cases.
